svg.title: Under-2000 upstairs Version E: Version B rooms, full primary bath and the Version D loft over the garage
svg.desc: Version E furnished preliminary diagram. It keeps the Version D over-garage arrangement exactly: a finished family loft opening off the gallery and continuing 8 feet east over the north garage, a 6 by 6.5 foot laundry with side-by-side front-load washer and dryer under a wraparound counter, and a provisional 3 by 3 foot furnace closet entered from the loft. There is no unfinished attic. Elsewhere it returns to Version B: the full 13 foot 7 inch by 13 foot 6 inch primary bath with tub, private toilet, 60-inch and 48-inch vanities, now with an 84 by 42 inch two-person shower with two heads. Closet 4 stays 6 by 5 feet clear and Closet 3 5.5 by 5.67 feet. To stay under 2,000, the primary bedroom west wall moves 2.3 feet east, making the bedroom 12 feet 5 inches by 19 feet 9 inches; the queen bed, nightstands, desk, two chairs and side table shift with it and the media console stays. Exterior-face gross area including walls and descending stairs, less the actual stair gap, is 1,997.6092 square feet, 2.3908 below 2,000. The primary bedroom setback creates a west-facade step above the ground floor that needs exterior and structural review. Floor framing over the garage span, roof and headroom, garage fire separation, furnace product, combustion air, venting, service clearance and dryer venting require professional review.
svg.text: Version E: Version B rooms + the Version D loft over the garage
PRELIMINARY DIAGRAM ONLY | 1,997.61 sq ft finished gross | 2.39 below 2,000 | No unfinished attic

Garage roof/headroom, floor loads and fire separation unresolved.
Furnace closet and laundry: provisional sizes
Furnace closet ~38 x 38 in clear for an upflow unit about 21 x 29 in; door opens to the loft for service.
Laundry machines assumed 27 in wide; 33-in-deep counter allows hoses and a dryer vent behind.
Laundry door swings in without touching counters; 39-in aisle in front of W / D.
All finished space; nothing unfinished. Total 1,997.61 sq ft.
HVAC contractor to confirm furnace size, clearances, combustion air, venting and returns.
Selected washer / dryer depth and dryer vent run may change the counter depth.
Floor framing over the garage span, roof/headroom and garage fire separation need professional review.

svg.text: Generic study footprints, not selected products. Static fit is not occupied-use approval; door swings, fixture spacing and storage capacity need review.
Over-garage floor, roof/headroom, fire separation, HVAC and plumbing require professional review. This diagram does not approve construction.
